text: わたくし　こども　たちと　せかいを　まわって　ますの　おほほ

structure.jp: せかいを　まわって　ますの
structure.en: am travelling around the world, you see

patterns.name: 〜ている
patterns.explanation: ている after a verb says the action is going on now; here the い is dropped, as often happens in speech. まわって　ます = 'am travelling around'.

patterns.name: 〜の (explaining)
patterns.explanation: の at the end of a statement gives it a soft 'you see' feeling; after the polite ます it sounds like a refined lady. まわって　ますの = 'I'm travelling around, you see'.

patterns.name: 〜と (together with)
patterns.explanation: と after a person means doing something together with them. こども　たちと = 'with my children'.
